licence_name: Gemeente Amsterdam Maps Data Gebruiksvoorwaarden (open licence, commercial use permitted)
proving_sentence_nl: De Gemeente Amsterdam verleent u hierbij een licentie voor het gebruiken en hergebruiken van de gedownloade dataset voor elk wettig doel. U mag de dataset zowel voor niet-commerciele als commerciele doeleinden gebruiken.
proving_sentence_en: The Municipality of Amsterdam grants you a license to use and reuse the downloaded dataset for any lawful purpose. You may use the dataset for both non-commercial and commercial purposes.
attribution_note: Bronvermelding niet verplicht, al op prijs gesteld (attribution not required but appreciated).
dataset_name: Bijzondere bomen (Special/monumental trees), dataset id 561, KAARTLAAG=BOMEN_BIJZONDER
scope_note: This is the city's own designated 'special trees' layer (Vastgestelde_status / Advies_status = protection-worthy designations), not a full street-tree inventory. It is a 'groeikaart' (growing map) being rolled out district by district, so coverage is uneven across Amsterdam as of this date and some districts are more complete than others.

field_notes.Plantjaar: Planting year, not an age. Age = current year minus Plantjaar; ages implied are mostly modest (many post-1970 plantings) since this layer also includes young/future 'champion' trees, not only ancient ones.
field_notes.Stamomtrek: Trunk girth, string field e.g. '323 cm'.
field_notes.Kroondiameter: Crown diameter range, string field e.g. '10 - 15 m'.
field_notes.Kampioenboom: Non-empty when the tree is flagged a 'champion tree' (record holder for size/species in the city).
field_notes.Vastgestelde_status / Advies_status: Designated / advised protection status, e.g. 'Beschermwaardige houtopstand' (worthy-of-protection stand); this is the semantic filter that makes the dataset usable per project rules (not a bulk inventory).
